d: Wild, voluminous long hair in a vibrant shade of rose pink flows backward with sharp, spiky textures. The eyes are narrow and piercing in a bright gold hue, set in a mature face featuring a prominent vertical scar crossing the left eye. The build is lean and athletic, dressed in a dark forest green open-chested coat with gold trim, a white asymmetrical wrap skirt, and vertically striped green and white stockings. Signature details include a large, ornate golden mechanical gauntlet on the right hand and a small rectangular accessory hanging from the waist.
